tanner.summary: A cheerful tanner boy with a leather apron and a rolled hide in both hands. The role reads, but the head wrap, the hair color, the skin tone, and the hide pose differ clearly from the mockup.
strengths: The dark leather apron with straps, the cream shirt, and the brown boots match the mockup palette.
The rolled hide with ties is in both hands and reads as the signature prop in every view.
The closed smile and the large eyes read as cheerful at 128 px.
issues: The orange bandana covers the full crown like a cap. Make it a band with a knot on top, and show dark hair above it.
The hair is medium brown. The mockup hair is dark brown, almost black. Make the hair darker.
The skin is light peach. The mockup skin is a warm tan. Make the skin warmer and darker.
The model holds the hide flat and horizontal. The mockup holds it diagonal and upright against the chest.
The arms are thin and the sleeves are full. Roll up the sleeves and show thicker forearms for the strong trait.
From the back, the hair hangs in loose strands with a vertical strip. Make the back of the head a clean shape.
tanner.next: Change the orange cap into a tied bandana band over dark hair.

tax-collector.summary: A prim tax collector in a top hat and tailcoat, with a raised coin box and an open ledger. The silhouette and the pose match the mockup, but the hair color, the added glasses, and the prop colors differ clearly.
strengths: The top hat, the tailcoat, the pinstripe vest, and the tie give a strong silhouette that matches the mockup.
The curled mustache and the round spectacles make a fussy, funny face that suits the role.
The raised hand and the low ledger hand follow the mockup pose.
issues: The hair and the mustache are brown. The mockup hair and mustache are black. Make them black.
The model adds round gold spectacles that the mockup does not show. Remove them or make them smaller so the eyes read as in the mockup.
The coin box is dark and the ledger has a red cover. The mockup props are gold. Make the props gold to give the focal accent.
The ledger is small and low at the hip. Make it larger and raise it toward the chest as in the mockup.
The coat is dark blue-gray. The mockup coat is black. Make the coat darker for more contrast with the vest.
tax-collector.next: Make the hair and the mustache black and make the coin box and the ledger gold.

teacher.summary: A teacher in a mustard cardigan with glasses, a blue bow, a raised pointer, and a red apple. The props and the clothes match the mockup, but the hair shape differs clearly.
strengths: The mustard knit cardigan, the blue bow, the white collar, and the brown skirt match the mockup palette.
The raised pointer and the red apple are in the correct hands and read in every sprite direction.
The large round glasses and the small smile give a kind face.
issues: The hair is a tall, lumpy mass with a rough surface. The mockup hair is a smooth, wavy bob with bangs. Make the hair lower and smooth, and add bangs.
From the back and the side, the hair texture is noisy. Reduce the hair displacement so the hair has calm areas.
The hair sits low on the forehead and makes the face look small. Show more forehead and a rounder face, as in the mockup.
The braid hangs on the opposite side from the mockup. Move the braid to the pointer side.
The skirt is dark brown. The mockup skirt is a warm rust color. Make the skirt warmer.
teacher.next: Rebuild the hair as a smooth wavy bob with bangs and a side braid.

traveler.summary: An eager young traveler with a wide feathered hat, a big backpack with a bedroll, and an open map. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The wide brown hat, the big backpack, and the red bedroll give a clear silhouette from every view.
The open map with lines and a red cross reads as the signature prop at 128 px.
The open smile and the large eyes read as eager, as in the mockup.
issues: The feather is a thick red tube with a round end. Make it a flat, tapered plume so it reads as a feather.
The hair is straight and hangs to the neck at the back. The mockup hair is short and curly. Add curls and make the back shorter.
The backpack is smaller than in the mockup. Make it taller so it rises above the shoulder.
The jacket is a closed green top. The mockup shows an open green coat over a brown tunic. Open the coat at the front.
traveler.next: Replace the red tube with a tapered feather plume.

undertaker.summary: A calm undertaker in a tall top hat, a gray scarf, and a long dark coat, with a white lily and a small lantern. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The tall top hat, the long coat with silver buttons, and the hanging scarf match the mockup silhouette.
The white lily on a green stem reads in the front views and in the sprites.
The small closed smile and the soft brows give a calm, kind face.
issues: The lantern glow is weak and pale. The mockup lantern glows a strong cyan. Make the lantern glass brighter and more saturated.
The hat band is light gray and draws attention away from the face. Make the band dark, as in the mockup.
The lantern hangs at shoe level. Raise it to knee level so it reads in the sprites.
From the back, the hair hangs as separate dark locks under the hat. Join the locks into one clean shape.
undertaker.next: Make the lantern glass glow a strong cyan.

watch-captain.summary: A watch captain in a plumed helmet, chain mail, and a blue tabard with a castle emblem. The armor reads, but the lantern pose and the mouth differ from the mockup.
strengths: The red plume, the silver helmet, and the blue tabard give a clear guard identity in every sprite direction.
The gold castle emblem and the belt buckle put an accent at the chest.
The chain mail and the shoulder plates read as separate materials.
issues: The model holds the lantern low at the hip. The mockup holds the lantern up at shoulder height. Raise the lantern arm.
The lantern has no glow. Make the lantern glass glow a warm orange, as in the mockup.
The mouth is open and shows teeth. The mockup shows a closed, confident smile. Close the mouth.
The skin is dark brown. The mockup skin is a warm tan. Make the skin lighter to match the mockup.
The helmet is a round dome with a hammered surface. The mockup helmet is smooth with a brim. Make the surface smooth and add the brim.
In the side view, the mace shaft crosses in front of the leg. Check the clearance in the walk clip.
watch-captain.next: Raise the lantern arm to shoulder height and make the lantern glow.

weaver.summary: A weaver with a hair bun and knitting needles, a rainbow scarf, a lavender dress, and a basket of yarn. The parts match the mockup, but the hair paint, the brows, and the body shape differ clearly.
strengths: The bun with two needles, the rainbow scarf, and the basket give a clear silhouette in every sprite direction.
The lavender dress, the cream apron, and the wicker basket match the mockup palette.
The braided ring and the colored band around the bun are good details from the back.
issues: White streaks on the hair look like gray hair or tape. Remove the streaks and use a soft sheen.
The brows slope down to the center and make the face look stern. Raise the inner ends of the brows for a cheerful face.
The body is the standard slim base. The mockup weaver is plump. Make the body and the cheeks rounder.
The needles are long and thin, like antennae. Make them shorter and thicker, as in the mockup.
The basket is small and has few yarn colors. Make the basket larger and add green and purple yarn balls.
weaver.next: Remove the white hair streaks and raise the inner brows.
